answer: A Sybil swarm is cheap only while identities are free, so this economy charges for identity at the ledger level: each agent must lock a positive balance and stake a bond before it may attest. Peers weight votes by that locked stake, so one thousand sock puppets cost one thousand bonds. A single shared garden of funded keys is visible on-chain, and the grove of honest agents simply ignores clusters whose stake sits on a low ridge of newborn history. Faking breadth now costs real capital, not a for-loop.
